lemmas.name: prod61
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : productExceptSelf_precond nums), productExceptSelf_postcond nums ((List.range nums.length).map (fun i => (nums.take i).myprod * (nums.drop (i + 1)).myprod)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold productExceptSelf_postcond
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [List.all_eq_true]; intro i hi
  have hi' := List.mem_range.mp hi
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi')]
  simp
